The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical statistics. This indicates that the formulas written to the workbook use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax. While the 'net metric' assertions passed, the final statistical calculations (EXPECTED_STATS) are broken.
